scope: Source and prior-evidence reconciliation for the FFN-down and linear-attention QKV source-Q6 family. No kernel, runtime, allocation, route, benchmark, or default changed.

model.tensor_family: 32 Q6_K FFN-down plus 24 Q6_K linear-attention QKV weights

llama_cpp_source_audit.backend_change: f26efa02a vulkan backend ops: implemented GATED_LINEAR_ATTN (#25601)
llama_cpp_source_audit.q6_path: On AMD, ggml_vk_should_use_mmvq rejects Q6 MMVQ and the rows-4 calls use the floating mul_mat_vec_q6_k path. The AMD selector retains subgroup-sized DMMV and chooses the NUM_COLS=4 pipeline. Both selector functions and all shader dependencies are unchanged.

hipengine_current_owner.decode: exact c1 and local128/col8 rows2-4; rows5-6 exact per-row fallback
hipengine_current_owner.memory: same bytes as legacy Q6T16; no sidecar allocation

existing_candidate_ladder: legacy Q6T16 c1, rows2-6, and dense WMMA M64/M512
local128 col16, row-selective col8, rejected col4, and BF16/F32 output policies
byte-neutral interleaved and planar qmicro plus aligned-record WMMA; scalar-record WMMA rejected
small-row planar-Q6 D4 integer-WMMA, rejected at 0.273-0.477x with 0/31 wins
FFN-down plus residual fusion, with rows2-3 retained and row4 rejected
planar-Q6/Q8_1 scalar sudot4 at c1 and rows2-4
equal-size rotating X8 c1 sidecar rescue, rejected because both complete-path designs regressed true AR by more than 6%

binding_prior_evidence.result: Exact row-selective col8 owner; col4 lost all nine actual rows2-4 cells and was removed.
Retained byte-neutral planar owner; 392-call W7900 family 59.876 -> 46.714 ms (-21.98%), with exact decode and prefill consumers.
Retained selective launch fusion for rows2-3; planar row4 arithmetic regressed 18.46% and was excluded.
Retained exact rounded add plus next-RMSNorm boundary and removed 217 B3 graph launches.
Planar Q8_1 and 3.140-GiB X8-c1 rescue improved B3 but regressed true AR by 6.23% and 6.87%; runtime and sidecar were removed.
Coverage matrix closes the legacy/planar/col4-col8/integer-WMMA/Q8_1 ladders and requires a new representation or hardware primitive before reopening.

decision.reason: The refreshed comparator changes neither the Q6 shader dependency graph nor the AMD path selectors. Vulkan still runs the same floating four-column Q6 matvec mechanism, while hipEngine has already measured dense, legacy T16, byte-neutral planar, geometry, fusion, integer-WMMA, Q8_1, and transaction-consistent sidecar alternatives. Repeating them would duplicate retained or rejected evidence.
decision.reopen_condition: A genuinely new byte-neutral or sole-resident Q6 representation, RDNA3 primitive, credible cross-family fusion with larger complete-wall impact, or changed comparator Q6 source.
decision.next_target: Advance D27-R2 to the refreshed full-attention K/V gap (4.958 ms hipEngine versus 2.040 ms Vulkan).
